title: The completed diagonal integral is a limit of a degree-zero system map
statement: Let l be prime, Y,P=P1(Y),W=P×Y P Noetherian with recorded localizations and l invertible on Y. Let D be simultaneous derived reduction on W and δ the normalized completed diagonal characterized by IsDiagonalLimit. For either projection f:W→P and any Result t over ULift(Q_l) for f, there is a SupportedSource a for t.Rc and a SingleTowerLimitWitness over DiagonalMod(l,P) for the scalar restriction of a.hom≫t.Rc.map(δ)≫t.trace. In particular the witness consists of one actual degree-zero tower endomorphism, its identity finite evaluations, the specified t.LS.R functor on the derived system category, the specified restricted coefficient-unit tower, and an invertible source comparison commuting with the completed integral. It does not infer equality of arbitrary derived arrows from evaluation.

theorem diagonalTrace_integrationSystems
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (hf : f = pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) ∨
      f = pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (t : Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f) :
    ∃ a : SupportedSource l Y f t.Rc,
      ∃ s : SingleTowerLimitWitness (DiagonalMod l (ProjectiveLine Y))
        ((diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (ProjectiveLine Y)).map
          (a.hom ≫ t.Rc.R.map δ ≫ t.trace)),
        s.tower = t.restrictionS.F.obj
          (SpTowerClasses.coefficient (ProjectiveLine Y)
            (SpTowerClasses.Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (ProjectiveLine Y))) ∧
        s.limitFunctor = t.LS.R
